title: Celebrate John Lennon’s Birthday with Special Programming on The Beatles Channel
summary: Hear special programming all week, including a two-part Sean Ono Lennon special, rare recordings, and more.
body_markdown:
Celebrate John Lennon’s birthday with a full week of special programming on[The Beatles Channel (Ch. 18)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/the-beatles-channel) .


[The Fab Four, 24/8 Everything dedicated to The Beatles Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogJohnLennonBirthdayTheBeatlesChannel)


From Monday, October 5, through Sunday, October 11, hear shows celebrating John’s life, music, and legacy — including a two-part special with his son Sean Ono Lennon, whose birthday he shares on Friday, October 9.


## **John Lennon Birthday Week on The Beatles Channel**


### **Sean Ono Lennon Special**


Sean Ono Lennon joins host David Fricke for a two-part series, sharing his favorite solo tracks from his father, John Lennon, as well as favorites from The Beatles.


**Airs:**


- Part 1: Friday, October 9 at 8pm ET
- Part 2: Sunday, October 11 at 12pm ET


### **Fab Fourum**


The Beatles Channel’s weekly live talk show brings listeners into the celebration as hosts Dennis Elsas, Bill Flanagan, and Tom Frangione take calls honoring John Lennon’s birthday. Def Leppard’s Joe Elliott will also join the fun to play their new version of Revolution.


**Airs:** Wednesday, October 7 at 9pm ET


### **Across the Universe**


Dennis Elsas hosts this weekly show dedicated to the life and music of John Lennon. For John’s birthday, Dennis welcomes fellow Beatles Channel hosts to share their favorite Beatles songs featuring John on lead vocals.


**Airs:**


- Tuesday, October 6 at 4pm ET
- Thursday, October 8 at 11pm ET
- Saturday, October 10 at 1pm ET


### **Mind Games Round Table**


Host David Fricke welcomes a panel of musicians and contributors who worked on John Lennon’s 1973 album *Mind Games* for a special birthday conversation. The panel features drummers Jim Keltner and Rick Marotta, guitarist David Spinozza, keyboardist Ken Ascher, and photographer Bob Gruen.


**Airs:** Wednesday, October 7 at 3pm ET


### **Breakfast with The Beatles**


Chris Carter dedicates three hours of his morning show to John Lennon’s music in celebration of his birthday.


**Airs:** Friday, October 9 at 8am ET


### **Eight Songs a Week — Times Two!**


Beatles Channel listeners take control as Meg Griffin hosts an expanded birthday edition of *Eight Songs a Week* . This time, fans rank their 16 favorite Beatles songs sung by John Lennon.


**Airs:**


- Friday, October 9 at 2pm ET
- Saturday, October 10 at 7pm ET
- Monday, October 12 at 1pm ET


### **From Me to You with Peter Asher**


In honor of John Lennon’s birthday, Peter Asher plays Beatles songs that John considered among his favorites by the Fab Four.


**Airs:**


- Thursday, October 8 at 9pm ET
- Saturday, October 10 at 5pm ET


### **Way Beyond Compare**


Beatles expert Tom Frangione explores alternate takes, live performances, and rarely heard versions of Beatles recordings. This week, Tom celebrates John’s birthday with rare Lennon tracks, including selections from the new *Rubber Soul* Special Edition.


**Airs:**


- Monday, October 5 at 2pm ET
- Tuesday, October 6 at 11pm ET


### **Northern Songs**


Beatles historian and author Bill Flanagan puts together a themed playlist of Fab Four hits and rarities, spotlighting John’s songs with The Beatles in honor of his birthday.


**Airs:**


- Monday, October 5 at 11pm ET
- Sunday, October 11 at 7pm ET


### **Dark Horse Radio**


Hosted by Laura Cantrell, *Dark Horse Radio* explores the music George Harrison wrote, produced, sang, and loved. This week, Laura celebrates John Lennon’s birthday by highlighting the special musical friendship between George and John.


**Airs:**


- Thursday, October 8 at 3pm ET
- Saturday, October 10 at 10am ET
- Sunday, October 11 at 4pm ET


## ***Power To The People* Concert Film**


To celebrate John Lennon’s birthday, October 9, Sean Ono Lennon, Mercury Studios, and Universal Music Group announced the release of the Blu-Ray Film Editions of *Power To The People* , the highly acclaimed 2026 multiscreen concert film of John Lennon & Yoko Ono’s legendary *One-To-One* live shows at Madison Square Garden, NYC in 1972 with Elephant’s Memory and Special Guests – newly restored, re-edited and remixed by the Lennons’ seven-times GRAMMY®-Award winning team, with music produced by Sean Ono Lennon. A 4-disc Deluxe Box Set, which also includes the award-winning documentary “One To One: John & Yoko,” will be released on April 9, 2027 and is available for pre-order now along with a two-disc option:[https://johnlennon.lnk.to/PowerToThePeople-Blu-RayPR](https://johnlennon.lnk.to/PowerToThePeople-Blu-RayPR)


For more information on John Lennon, visit[www.johnlennon.com](http://www.johnlennon.com/) .
